newsitem.title: USA: Grove Bank to acquire Greater Boston Bank.
newsitem.headline: Grove Bank to acquire Greater Boston Bank.

text.p: Grove Bank said on Tuesday it has agreed to acquire Greater Boston Bank for about $18 million in cash and stock.
Grove Bank said the deal is expected to be accretive to Grove Bank earnings in the first year following the merger.
The deal, which is subject to regulatory approves and certain closing conditions, is expected to close in early 1997, Grove Bank said.

Greater Boston, which had deposits of $143.6 million and total assets of $167.2 million as of June 30, 1996, will be acquired for $13.1 million in cash and 166,102 shares of Grove Bank common stock, Grove Bank said.
The value of the transaction is 1.38 times Greater Boston's book equity of $13 million, Grove Bank said.
